title: Desk Q&A: Storage Unit Tenants Bringing a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Current
content:
**Q. Does renting a storage unit change what a parking tenant pays to bring a delinquent Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement current?**

Yes. A tenant who also holds an active storage unit rental under a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement moved into at least 24 months before the handling date has $5.00 left on the next statement; a tenant whose active storage unit rental was moved into more recently has $2.50 left on it; a tenant with no active storage unit rental leaves nothing on that account. The amount left is left on the next statement rather than collected: it is taken off the amount to pay now, and the result is rounded to the cent.

**Q. Which records decide it?** The tenant's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement records: whether a rental stands active, and its move-in date. Months are whole calendar months from the move-in date to the handling date, counted to the same day of the later month; at exactly 24 months the $5.00 figure applies.

**Q. The tenant's only storage unit was vacated last year.** No active storage unit rental: nothing is left on that account.

**Q. Hypothetical figures?**

| Storage unit record | Left on the next statement | Amount to pay otherwise $163.75 becomes |
|---|---|---|
| Active, moved in 31 months ago | $5.00 | $158.75 |
| Active, moved in 7 months ago | $2.50 | $161.25 |
| No active unit | nothing | $163.75 |
